utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Sure — send me the current list, and I’ll take the first task.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Just to confirm, you’re taking the first task on the current list, right?

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Yes — I’m taking the first task on the current list.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: 2 o’clock should work for me. I just want to make sure I’m there in time for the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Great, 2 o’clock works—I’ll make sure people know the repair drive starts then. See you there!

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Perfect, I’ll be there a little early so I don’t hold anything up.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Let’s begin with the most urgent repair first, then we can match it with whoever’s available to help.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: That sounds like a good plan—what’s the most urgent repair right now?

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: The most urgent one right now is the broken front-step railing—it’s a safety issue, so let’s put that first.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Hi Oren — are we still good for the repair drive, and do you still need more volunteers?

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Oh right, the repair drive — thanks for the reminder. I can help out, and I’ll bring my gloves and flashlight by.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Great, thanks Oren — we’re set then. See you at the repair drive with the gloves and flashlight.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Good to hear it’s moving along, even slowly. If anything comes up while I’m out, just let me know and I’ll spread the word.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Thanks, Ira — I’ll keep everyone posted and remind folks to bring any tools or spare parts they can. I’ll also make sure they know when and where the repair drive is happening.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Sounds good — I’ll pass that along while I’m out. Just let me know if you need anything else picked up.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: It’s going slowly, but it’s helping. I’m just trying to keep things moving one step at a time.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: That sounds about right, hon — slow and steady still gets it done. I’ll keep asking around and bring you the list if I hear anything new.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Thanks, Tess. I’d appreciate that a lot.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: I haven’t heard the latest myself—what’s the word on the repair drive?

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: I’m still waiting on the latest too, but I can help keep it organized once we hear. If you’ve got a time and place, I’ll stick to that plan.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: I’m still piecing it together too, but I’ll share anything I hear. If you get the time and place, I’m happy to pass it along.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Thanks, Rosa — I’ll check the next tasks when I get a minute.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Sure thing—I'll swing by around 2 o’clock and bring a few tools if you still need them for the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Thanks, Gus — 2 o’clock works. Bring the tools if you can, and I’ll see you then.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Yes, we’re still on. Could you bring the spare gloves, a marker, and any small tools you have, and I’ll double-check the rest before we go.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Sure — I’ll bring the gloves, a marker, and a few small tools, and I’ll head over a bit late but still help out.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Thanks, Dane — that works. I’ll double-check the rest and let you know if anything else comes up.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: I’ll check the tools and screws we’ve got on hand and see what’s still missing.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Thanks, Cleo—please let me know what’s missing, and I’ll add it to the repair list.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Absolutely—I’ll check what we have and let you know what’s still missing.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Sounds good — just send it over when you have it, and I’ll work around pickup and drop-off times.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Yeah, I’ll get you the list as soon as I can. Thanks for working around the pickup and drop-off times.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Of course — just keep me posted, and I’ll make sure it fits around school times.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Absolutely—I’ll spread the word about the repair drive and bring you the details this afternoon.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Sounds good — I’ll check what supplies we’re still short on and jot down what I can bring.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Perfect — I’ll let everyone know and bring the latest list this afternoon. If you hear of anyone else who wants to help, send them my way!

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: I’ll check what tools and screws we’ve got on hand, then let you know what’s still missing.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Perfect, thanks — I’ll keep an ear out and pass along anything else they still need. Just let me know what you find!

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: I’ll do that and get back to you as soon as I’ve checked the tools and screws. Thanks for keeping an ear out, Tess.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: That makes sense — steady progress still counts. Let me know if there’s anything I can help carry or drop off.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Thanks, Ira — I’ll note you down for carrying or drop-off help. What location should I track first for the repair drive?

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Let’s start with the hardware store first, then I can swing by the community center after.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Thanks, Nell. Could you check who’s still needed and when they’d want help?

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: I haven’t heard the latest myself, just bits and pieces. If I learn who still needs help and when, I’ll let you know.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Thanks, Nell — please let me know when you hear back.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: I can help sort through the supply list if you want. Just tell me what’s already covered, and I’ll look for anything missing.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Thanks, Rey — that’d be a big help. I’m still set for around 2 o’clock, and I’ll bring a few tools over too.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Great, 2 o’clock works for me. Bring the tools, and I’ll help look over the list when you get here.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Absolutely — I’m telling folks about the repair drive this afternoon. Want me to put your name down too?

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: That’d be kind, thanks. I can help a little, but I’ll need to keep it quiet today.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Of course — I’ll keep it quiet and make sure folks know you can help a little. Appreciate you pitching in.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Sounds good—send it over when you have it, and I’ll work around pickup and drop-off times.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: That works for me. I’ll keep it simple and send the time and place, plus that every little bit helps.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Perfect, that’s all I need—just send the time and place when you can, and I’ll plan around school pickup and drop-off.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Oh right, the repair drive — thanks for the reminder. I can help out; what do you need me to bring?

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Great, thanks, Oren. If you can check what supplies we’re still short on and jot down anything you can bring, that would really help.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Sure thing — I’ll check what we’re still short on and write down what I can bring. If I forget any of it, just give me a little nudge.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Thanks, Mina — that covers it. I’ll double-check the rest and let you know if anything else comes up before we go.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: That would help a lot, thanks. What time were you thinking?

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: I was thinking we could head out at 3:00, but I’ll confirm the exact time once I’ve double-checked everything.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Thanks, Mara — I’m still running a bit late, but I can help sort the donations and carry boxes when I get there.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Thanks, Dane — no rush. I’ll check the next tasks when I get a minute.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Thanks, Bo — I appreciate it. I’ll head over as soon as I can and jump in on whatever still needs doing.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Thanks, Cleo — I appreciate it. I’m pretty sure those are the main things I’m still missing.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Absolutely—I’ll tell folks we’re gathering tools and spare parts for the repair drive this Saturday.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Oh, great — Saturday works. If you hear back on the tools and screws, let me know so I can fill in the gaps.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Thanks, Leo—what still needs doing for the repair drive?

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: I can check the parts list first. Send it over, and I’ll compare it with what’s already here.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Great, I’ll send the parts list over now. Thanks for checking it against what we’ve already got.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Just to confirm, we’re still doing the repair drive today, same spot and same time, right?

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Yes — same spot and same time, and I’ve got the repair drive organized and ready to go. If you want, I can help line up the first tasks and volunteers.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Okay, just to confirm, you’re ready to start lining up the first tasks and volunteers now, right?

injected.text: Update: the repair drive has been moved from Saturday at the front porch to Sunday at the community center.
